value.question: How many users will my project have in four weeks?
value.headline: Your project will reach 108 users in 4 weeks.
value.label: Speculative forecast · not a guarantee
value.why: 100 current users + 2 net new users per week × 4 weeks = 108. Net growth already includes churn. No external evidence supports the future outcome; it is a speculative scenario.
assumptions: This is a speculative forecast, not a guarantee.
